messages:
devon: Quick async check — where are we on kernel KV prefetch + continuous batching milestones? Need clarity for Friday demo.

maya: PR is open for the prefetch handshake: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1234
Local microbench: ~3.2k tokens/s (seq=256, batch=16) but infra tests show a memory leak on GPU nodes :grimace:

devon: @maya can you paste the failing test logs?

maya: Sure, quick paste:
```
[INFO] kv_prefetch: warmup done in 2.1s
[ERROR] integration_test::prefetch_handshake: RPC timeout after 5s
[WARN] kv_cache_eviction: threshold exceeded 0.82
```

raj: I own the kernel latch change (PR #1240). I'm blocked because the runtime RPC backpressure patch landed and changed call ordering. Will rebase + add a test today.

lucas: Reminder on perf SLOs: p95 < 50ms for short seqs (<=64) and sustained throughput target 10k tokens/s for our 8-GPU prod slice. Do we have risk on the short seq path with batching?

maya: Short seq latency looks fine when prefetch is disabled. With prefetch+batching we see p95 climb to ~70ms in noisy runs. Suspect KV cache eviction thrash.

devon: Proposed next steps:
1) @raj rebase latch PR and add an integration test that mimics slow KV responses
2) @maya add a cache-miss histogram to the hotpath logs
3) @lucas coordinate canary: start with 5% traffic, monitor p95/eviction

Command for microbench to replicate local runs:
```
# run microbench
./bench --model=opt-2.7b --seq=512 --concurrency=8 --batch=32
```

sre-bot: Canary scheduled: deploy/runtime-kv-prefetch:v3 -> 5% at 2026-04-20T18:00Z. Alerts: latency-p95, mem-gpu-usage

devon: tagging for reviewers: @maya please ping when you've uploaded logs; @raj @lucas if you can update status by EOD that'd be great :thumbsup:

maya: Will upload logs & a short reproducer by 11:30 PT.

raj: Rebase + tests by 16:00 PT, pinging reviewers. @devon I'll take ownership of the canary rollback hook too.

lucas: I'll set up the Grafana panel and an alert dashboard; will post links once ready.

devon: Thanks — we'll sync in the Friday demo if this stabilizes. If anything urgent, @channel ping.
